namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests

    public class LoggerExtensionsTests

        public LoggerExtensionsTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            _mockLogger.Setup(x => x.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Error)).Returns(true);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogError_CalledWithLine206Format_ExecutesCorrectly()
        {
            // Arrange
            var sourceNodeId = "sourceNode123";
            var targetNodeId = "targetNode456";
            var messageTemplate = "Failed to relinquish ownership from source node:({srcNode}) to target node: ({tgtNode})";

            // Act - Execute EXACT LogError extension method call from line 206
            _mockLogger.Object.LogError(messageTemplate, sourceNodeId, targetNodeId);

            // Assert - Verify the underlying ILogger.Log method was called with Error level
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogError_WithMigrationNodeIds_UsesStructuredLogging()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = _mockLogger.Object;
            var srcNode = "node-1";
            var tgtNode = "node-2";

            // Act - Replicates the exact ILogger.LogError extension call from MigrationDriver.cs line 206
            logger.LogError("Failed to relinquish ownership from source node:({srcNode}) to target node: ({tgtNode})", srcNode, tgtNode);

            // Assert - Confirms structured logging parameters are captured correctly

            logger?.LogError("Test message with params {param1} {param2}", "value1", "value2");

            // Assert - No exception thrown (extension method handles null safely)
            Assert.True(true);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogError_MultipleParams_MatchesMigrationDriverPattern()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = _mockLogger.Object;

            // Act - Matches the 2-parameter LogError pattern from line 206
